summary: Retire missing tracked GitHub nodes without failing healthy item observations

schema.detail: No database or cursor schema changes.

compatibility.detail: A NOT_FOUND error at an exact tracked nodes index with a null result records state=closed, state_reason=deleted and deleted=true for that item and removes its identity from the polling cursor. Other nodes are retained. Other errors and repository-wide NOT_FOUND still fail the observation.

manual.detail: Missing identities retire automatically on their next detail read.
